Name: Azariah, Son of Obed
Summary: Azariah, son of Obed, was one of the captains of hundreds Jehoiada took into covenant to crown Joash.
KeyStory: Jehoiada took Azariah the son of Obed into covenant with him.
RelatedPeople: Jehoiada, the Priest; Obed, Father of Azariah
LifeLesson: Five captains together turned a hidden child into a crowned king.
